cues.text: These two accounts hold a total of one hundred fifty units.
cues.concept: Two balances contribute to one conserved total.
cues.metaphor: Two transparent containers holding measured quantities.
cues.behavior: Construct the containers and fill them to 100 and 50 units.
cues.camera: Establish both containers and the relationship between them.
cues.next: A portion of the left balance becomes a traveling quantity.
risks: Keep balance labels clear of container outlines.

cues.text: Ten units move from the left account to the right.
cues.concept: A transfer has an origin, an in-flight state and a destination.
cues.metaphor: An extracted portion travels along the connection.
cues.behavior: Remove ten from the left, show ten in transit, then add ten to the right.
cues.camera: Track the quantity while retaining both endpoints.
cues.next: The arriving portion changes the right balance.
cues.silentMeaning: The same quantity moves rather than being created twice.
risks: Moving portion must clear both container outlines and labels.

cues.text: The balances change, while the total stays the same.
cues.metaphor: The same total marker spans the changed container levels.
cues.behavior: Settle the arriving portion and connect final balances to the unchanged total.
cues.camera: Reframe the whole relationship without resetting the world.
cues.next: Retain the two balances as anchors for a subsequent explanation if needed.
cues.silentMeaning: The distribution changed but the total did not.
risks: Allow reading time for the final quantitative relationship.
